evals.prompt: Dry-run the current weekly One-on-One prep. Show the exact Week-N window and coverage, but do not write to Feishu or send a message.
evals.expected_output: Computes the deterministic half-open Friday window, performs collection/review, and reports write.occurred=false and notification.attempted=false.

evals.prompt: Prepare Week-2 again when exactly one Week-2 child already exists and notification state contains the same verified node token.
evals.expected_output: Updates the unique Week-2 child, verifies it by fetch and parent listing, and suppresses the duplicate success notification.

evals.prompt: Prepare the weekly One-on-One when two children under the configured parent Wiki are both titled Week-2.
evals.expected_output: Stops before writing, does not guess a target, and returns a duplicate-title failure with write.occurred=false.

evals.prompt: Prepare the weekly One-on-One when local Git is readable but browser history fails, while Lark and ByteDance families are healthy.
evals.expected_output: Retries browser once, records an individual local coverage gap, continues because the local family is still usable, and includes the gap in the result/notification.
